question: A 5-man group made up of one tank, one healer, and three DPS is doing a dungeon that was just released in World of Warcraft. Two are plate wearers and two are cloth wearers. At the final boss, both the tank and the healer are casting holy spells. Ice and fire are being used, each one by a different DPS. A bear from the group is attacking the boss. Metamorphosis is cast. The Kilt of the Forgotten One drops as loot, but no one can use it. If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?
ground_truth: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

history.name: WoW_Mechanics_Expert
history.content: Task recap and initial plan: We need five unique classes satisfying these signals: 1 tank, 1 healer, 3 DPS; exactly two plate wearers and two cloth wearers; the tank and healer are casting holy; DPS include one using ice and another using fire; someone in the group is a bear attacking; Metamorphosis is cast; and the Kilt of the Forgotten One drops but no one can use it. My upfront mapping: Paladin likely tanks and casts holy; Priest likely heals and casts holy. Warlock covers Metamorphosis and can do fire. Ice can be covered by a Frost Death Knight. Bear suggests Druid. The armor distribution would then be Paladin + Death Knight (plate), Priest + Warlock (cloth), Druid (leather). That leaves the loot clue: if Kilt is a type no one can wear (e.g., mail), that would explain 'no one can use it.' Let's confirm the item type before we lock in.

history.name: LogicExpert
history.content: I'll formalize constraints and resolve the loot clue precisely. Constraints: 2 plate (P), 2 cloth (C), 1 other; Paladin tank (holy), Priest healer (holy); Warlock Metamorphosis (and fire); Frost DK covers ice; Druid explains the bear. To avoid assumption errors about the Kilt, I will use the Computer_terminal to fetch the exact armor type of 'Kilt of the Forgotten One' from Wowhead so we can deduce whether mail is absent. This should give us a definitive signal for excluding mail classes.

history.name: Computer_terminal
history.content:
exitcode: 0 (execution succeeded)
Command: curl -s https://www.wowhead.com/item=34384 | grep -i "class" -A2
Parsed snippet:
"Kilt of the Forgotten One" — Leg Armor, Mail, ilvl 154 (Sunwell Plateau). Usable by: Hunter, Shaman.
Derived classification: Item type = Mail.
Conclusion: If no one can use it, there are no mail wearers present in the group.

history.name: Verification_Expert
history.content: Given the terminal's mail classification for the Kilt, 'no one can use it' means the party contains no mail wearers, so exclude Hunter and Shaman. Keep two plate: Paladin, Death Knight. Keep two cloth: Priest, Warlock. The bear clue is Druid. Metamorphosis is Warlock; fire is Warlock, ice is Death Knight. Tank Paladin (holy), healer Priest (holy). Armor distribution: plate (Paladin, DK), cloth (Priest, Warlock), leather (Druid). Loot explanation: the Kilt is mail and nobody wears mail, so no one can use it. This fits all constraints.

history.name: WoW_Mechanics_Expert
history.content:
Double-checking role and spell assignments:
- Tank: Paladin (plate, holy) ✔
- Healer: Priest (cloth, holy) ✔
- DPS: Death Knight (ice via Frost) ✔
- DPS: Warlock (fire via Destruction, Metamorphosis via Demonology) ✔
- DPS: Druid (bear form providing the 'bear attacking' clue) ✔
Armor: 2 plate (Paladin, DK), 2 cloth (Priest, Warlock), 1 leather (Druid). No mail present, consistent with the Kilt being mail and unusable by the group.

history.name: LogicExpert
history.content:
Alphabetizing the set for final output: {Paladin, Priest, Warlock, Death Knight, Druid} → Death Knight, Druid, Paladin, Priest, Warlock.
Quick sanity: all classes unique; holy assigned to tank/healer; ice and fire used by different DPS (DK and Warlock). Bear is Druid. Kilt (mail) unused because no mail class. This passes our checks.

history.name: Verification_Expert
history.content:
Final verification checklist:
- Count armor: 2 plate (Paladin, DK), 2 cloth (Priest, Warlock). ✔
- Holy casters: Paladin (tank), Priest (healer). ✔
- Ice DPS: DK. Fire DPS: Warlock. ✔
- Bear present: Druid. ✔
- Metamorphosis: Warlock. ✔
- Loot unusable: mail Kilt, no mail wearers. ✔
Everything aligns. Approve the final list.

history.name: Computer_terminal
history.content:
Optional exhaustive check via brute-force enumeration (pseudo-output):
Generated all 5-class sets meeting armor distribution and ability tags. Valid set found: [Death Knight, Druid, Paladin, Priest, Warlock].
Other candidate with Mage breaks cloth count. No mail-bearing combination accepted due to loot constraint. Proceeding with the approved set.

history.name: WoW_Mechanics_Expert
history.content: Final answer (alphabetical): Death Knight, Druid, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

mistake_reason: LogicExpert chose to invoke the Computer_terminal to web-scrape the armor type of 'Kilt of the Forgotten One', a task that should have been resolved through internal game knowledge and reasoning. This unnecessary tool selection (FM-4.3) produced a misleading classification (mail) that drove the team to exclude mail classes (e.g., Hunter) and include Druid to satisfy the bear clue. The reliance on the inappropriate external tool caused the wrong final class list.
